caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair with armrests, viewed at a slight angle. The chair features a high, gently curved backrest ending in two vertical posts, each topped with a rounded finial. The backrest is a lighter wood color with visible grain patterns, while the armrests are a slightly darker brown, curving outward at the ends. The seat and frame of the chair are made of the same light-colored wood as the backrest. The front apron of the seat has a decorative, wavy cutout. Four straight legs support the chair, joined by horizontal stretchers for additional stability. The background is a plain, off-white color with scattered small brown spots. In the lower right corner, the name "Edward I. Jewett" is written in small, precise text.
title: Chair
